# Salesforce Analytics Embedding SDK — Example Apps

> Canonical, framework-spanning example apps that demonstrate
> `@salesforce/analytics-embedding-sdk` (Tableau Next embedded analytics) in
> React 19, Vanilla JS, and Angular 22. Each example covers Dashboard, Metric,
> Visualization, AnalyticsAgent, and recoverable error UX.

## SDK
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@salesforce/analytics-embedding-sdk
- Official docs: https://developer.salesforce.com (Tableau Next embedded analytics)
- Source examples in this repo: `examples/`

## Examples
- `examples/react-vite/` — React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript strict; class API; `react-router-dom` v7
- `examples/vanilla-js/` — Plain HTML + ES modules, no build; HTML custom-element API; CDN-loaded SDK
- `examples/angular/` — Angular 22 standalone components; signals; class API; `loadComponent` lazy routing

## Auth
- Phase 1 (this repo today): user pastes a Salesforce **frontdoor URL** into an in-app config form. Stored in `localStorage`. Demo only — sandbox orgs only.
- Phase 2 (planned): backend samples that mint frontdoor URLs server-side from OAuth tokens. Will live under `auth-backend/`.
- Concept doc: `docs/how-to-get-frontdoor-url.md`

## Key SDK API surface demonstrated
- `initializeAnalyticsSdk(config)` — bootstraps a session against an org
- `Status.SUCCESS` / `Status.FAILURE` — init result discrimination
- `OrgStates.AUTH_REDIRECT` — MFA / password-reset path
- `retryOrAddOrgs` — retry after auth redirect
- `AnalyticsDashboard` — embedded dashboard (class API and `<analytics-dashboard>` element)
- `AnalyticsMetric` — embedded metric tile
- `AnalyticsVisualization` — single visualization
- `AnalyticsAgent` — Agentforce analytics agent
- `EventName.ERROR` — runtime error subscription
- `.remove()` — lifecycle cleanup (each embed is an HTMLElement; detaching it disposes it)

## Cross-example consistency
- localStorage keys: `analytics-sdk-demo:orgUrl`, `analytics-sdk-demo:authCredential`
- Routes: `/` (Showcase), `/agent` (AnalyticsAgent). Vanilla uses `index.html`, `showcase.html`, `agent.html`.
- Validation: `orgUrl` must be a well-formed `https://` URL; the SDK validates the actual host at init time (Salesforce Lightning hosts vary too much to allowlist).
- Error message keys identical across examples: `INVALID_ORG_URL`, `AUTH_REDIRECT`, `INIT_FAILED`, `RENDER_FAILED`, `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`.
